title: Extended Source Code Headers
prompt: Extend/change/refactor all source code headers to include: ID, Summary, Contributors, License section, and Specs section. Support all languages. Ensure 100% of source code files have the new header. Move file-wide requirements from AGENTS.md and README.md to source code headers. Extend existing tests. No legacy API or backwards compatibility.
